---
title: "Personal Visualization Journey"
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Import the CSV file
step_data <- read_csv("Steps.csv")

step_data <- step_data %>% 
  rename(date = 1, steps = Actual) %>% 
  mutate(date = mdy(date))

head(step_data)
```
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

plot_data <- step_data |>
  mutate(
    month_num = month(date),
    season = case_when(
      month_num %in% c(12, 1, 2)  ~ "Winter",
      month_num %in% c(3, 4, 5)   ~ "Spring",
      month_num %in% c(6, 7, 8)   ~ "Summer",
      month_num %in% c(9, 10, 11) ~ "Fall"
    ) |> factor(levels = c("Winter", "Spring", "Summer", "Fall"))
  )

 ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = date, y = steps)) +
  geom_line(color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(aes(color = season), size = 2.3, alpha = 0.9) +
  
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Season",
    values = c(
      "Winter" = "#2B8CBE",  # Crisp blue
      "Spring" = "#2CA25F",  # Fresh green
      "Summer" = "#E69F00",  # Warm golden yellow
      "Fall"   = "#D95F02"   # Burnt orange
    )
  ) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b %Y", date_breaks = "2 months") +
  labs(
    title = "Weekly Step Counts Across Seasons (2025-2026)",
    x = NULL, # "Date" is self-explanatory from "Jan 2025", etc.
    y = "Total Steps"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.4),
    legend.position = "top" )

```
